name: Calendar Notes
description: A minimal month-view calendar for keeping day-by-day notes.
releaseNotes: A full settings panel arrives: calendar styles (a classic full month or a floating five-week strip), cell styles (per-line numbering or bullets), fonts, sizes, and colors for the calendar, today ring, selection, festivals and solar terms — all persisted through the plugin's sidecar and preserved across upgrades. Notes gain instant search with highlighted matches and a date picker in the month title for jumping straight to any day.
